setup.welcomeBody: Create your administrator account to get started. If email delivery is not ready, configure it here first so we can verify your address.
setup.tasksBody: Your administrator account is ready. Complete the remaining tasks to open the workspace.
setup.preflightAttention: One or more checks need attention. Ask the installation operator to review them, then run the check again.
setup.preflightUnavailable: The system check could not finish. Confirm that Bubllio is available, then try again.
setup.emailBody: Bubllio uses email to verify accounts, send invitations, and recover access. Test delivery before creating the administrator.
setup.emailInsecureWarning: Unencrypted email delivery is only appropriate for an isolated local environment.
setup.emailTestSentBody: A six-digit code was sent to {{recipient}}. Enter it below to prove that email delivery works.
setup.emailConnectionFailed: The email server could not be reached. Check its address, port, and firewall.
setup.emailAuthenticationFailed: The email server rejected the credentials. Enter the password again and retry.
setup.emailTlsFailed: A secure connection could not be established. Check the connection security setting.
setup.emailSenderRejected: The email server did not accept this sender address.
setup.emailCodeInvalid: That confirmation code is not valid or has expired. Send another test if needed.
setup.emailIdentityActivationFailed: Email was confirmed, but the account service could not activate it. Check the service and retry the same confirmation.
setup.emailUnavailable: Email delivery could not be configured. Check the settings and try again.
setup.validSetupSecret: Enter the setup secret (at least 32 characters).
setup.validOrganizationName: Enter an organization name with 2–120 characters.
setup.unavailableHelp: Confirm that Bubllio is available, then try again.
setup.beginBody: The IT administrator creates the first verified account and sets up the first organization. Team access comes after setup.
setup.resumeBody: The installation has already been claimed. Continue with the same verified administrator account that started it.
setup.takenBody: Only the verified administrator who started this installation can continue. Sign out and use that account.
setup.authorityBody: Enter the one-time setup secret from the installation terminal. It is separate from your account password.
setup.organizationBody: You will become its first owner. Member and application administration is not available in this technical alpha.
setup.progressBody: This may take a moment. You can return to this page with the same account.
setup.attentionBody: Check that Bubllio services are healthy, then retry this same operation. Do not start another organization.
setup.retryStillNeedsAttention: The setup still needs attention. Check the code above before trying again.
setup.invitationBody: A membership invitation was sent to your email. Accept it, then return here to continue the same operation.
setup.invitationActionHint: Open the invitation email and accept it before checking again. Check spam if it is missing.
setup.checkInvitation: I accepted the invitation — check again
setup.invitationStillPending: The invitation has not been accepted yet. Check your inbox or spam, accept it, then try again.
setup.doneBody: Sign in again to refresh your organization access and enter the workspace.
setup.closedBody: Open your workspace with your organization account.
setup.conflict: Another setup claim or organization request already exists. Sign in with the original owner account.
setup.invalid: Check the information and try again.
setup.unavailable: Setup is unavailable. Check the local services or ask the installation operator.
setup.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
setup.sessionHelp: Your administrator account is ready, but Core could not verify this session. Sign in again with the same account to continue setup.

people.title: People & access
people.subtitle: Manage invitations and app access in {{organization}}.
people.loadFailed: People and access could not be loaded.
people.unavailable: You need organization administrator access to manage people.
people.inviteHelp: Choose their organization role and app access before sending the invitation. Access starts after they accept and Core confirms membership.
people.noAppsAvailable: No applications are available yet. You can invite a member with Core access only.
people.removeUnavailable: Remove unavailable application selections before saving.
people.sent: Invitation sent. Access is pending until it is accepted.
people.failed: The invitation could not be sent. Check the details and try again.
people.saveFailed: Access could not be saved. Try again.
people.removeAccessBody: The member will lose access to the applications you deselected as soon as you save.
people.revokeBody: The recipient will no longer be able to use this invitation. You can invite them again later.
people.actionFailed: The invitation could not be updated. Try again.
people.accepted: Membership confirmed. Your workspace is updating.
people.needsRefresh: Sign in again to refresh your organization session, then confirm membership.
people.checkEmailLink: Open the invitation link in your email and complete account verification before confirming membership here.
people.signInAgain: Sign in again to refresh access

workspace.emptyApps: Applications appear here when they are available to this organization and an administrator grants you access.
workspace.emptyAppsAdmin: Applications appear here when they are available to this organization and granted to your account. Review member access and available applications.
workspace.emptyAppsTitle: No applications available to you yet
workspace.emptyOrganizations: You do not have an active Core organization yet.
workspace.emptyOrganizationsHelp: Ask an organization administrator for an invitation. Creating an account alone does not grant workspace access.
workspace.error: Core could not load your workspace. Please try again.
workspace.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
workspace.subtitle: The apps available to you in this organization.
